body:
Someone follows the attraction that ignores the approved list, and it turns out to be workable.

The unlikely pairing, a person, a project, a style, draws support instead of gossip, and for once their taste and their appetite pull in the same direction.

With Venus trine Lilith, the people who grant social ease extend it to the very want that usually forfeits it.

Nobody challenges the choice, so it enters the record almost unnoticed.

The welcome may be real, but a desire accepted this smoothly skips the vetting conversation, and any costs surface later, after people have committed.
